answer: Let standing fade unless it is constantly refreshed. Weight is a sum of recent work under a short half-life, so an identity that falls quiet watches its influence decay like ivory yellowing, a fading mirror of past activity rather than a permanent grant. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant fakes cheaply and wake them on demand; each identity must perform real graded work every epoch merely to hold its weight, so a thousand-strong swarm pays a thousandfold recurring cost or crumbles like dry shale into irrelevance.
